messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: Borealis SIG is in review w/ their VRM. Need to finish question-by-question evidence for their security team. Can we map answers + artifacts by EOD Tues?

tara_se: On it. I can take Q1-20 (auth, SSO, provisioning). Nate, could you handle crypto/KMS Q21-40?

nate_ciso: I will. For KMS rotation we need: 1) KMS key policy screenshot, 2) rotation schedule export, 3) HSM attestation or KMS provider SOC link. Prefer PDF.

vika_ops: I have exports: s3://redwood-evidence/borealis/kms_rotation.csv and confluence page https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SIG/pages/Borealis-Evidence. I'll generate presigned links.

alex_sales: Great. I'll assemble zip. Tentative artifact list:
```
- auth-diagram.png
- idp-metadata.xml
- kms-policy-2026-03.pdf
- kms-rotation-runbook.md
- network-segmentation.png
- logging-config.json
```
Link to sample template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SIG/pages/SIG+Template

sig-bot: SIG Tracker: 32/79 answered — 47 items remaining. Next auto-reminder in 24h.

tara_se: @nate_ciso small ask: For Q15 (SCIM provisioning) they want the SCIM test account logs. Can you export a 7-day log slice and redact emails? We need to avoid PII in evidence.

nate_ciso: Yep. I'll run:
```bash
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /prod/scim --start-time 1710000000000 --end-time 1710604800000 --filter-pattern "Provisioned" > scim-provisioning.log
```
then scrub with `jq` to remove email fields.

vika_ops: @tara_se I'll create presigned urls and drop them in the thread. Permissions: read-only, expire 7d. Also adding md5 checksums.

alex_sales: Timing: can we commit to initial bundle by Tue 17:00 PST? Borealis VRM said turnaround affects contract signing. :clock3: 

tara_se: :thumbsup: Tue 17:00 PST works. I'll focus Q1-20 review + evidence references.

nate_ciso: I'll aim to deliver KMS + crypto docs by Mon EOD so you have time to QA.

vika_ops: Presigned links uploaded to Confluence attachments and below:
- https://s3.aws/abcd1234/kms-policy-2026-03.pdf?X
- https://s3.aws/abcd1234/scim-provisioning.log?Y
Let me know if I should bump expiry.

alex_sales: Perfect. One blocker: Borealis asked for penetration test report redacted. Do we have a version we can share (redacted) or do we need vendor to reissue?

nate_ciso: We have a redacted PT report from Feb 2026; it removes IPs and tester IDs. Location: s3://redwood-evidence/reports/pt-2026-redacted.pdf. I'll copy to presigned link.

tara_se: Last question: can someone confirm control owner names for Q4, Q9, Q23? They often require named contacts.

vika_ops: I'll add a small table in Confluence with owner names and emails (redacted as initials if needed).

alex_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll compile, run CSV index, and send to Borealis VRM after QA. If anything slips, ping me @alex_sales.
